name: sv-nd-scribe-vscode
description: SV ND Scribe: Real-time NaturalDocs documentation and formatting feedback for SystemVerilog

commands.title: SV_Scribe: Fix all auto-fixable issues in file
SV_Scribe: Fix specific rule in file
SV_Scribe: Overwrite File Header from Template
SV_Scribe: Open Header Template to Edit
SV_Scribe: Reset Header Template to Default

sv-nd-scribe.linterPath.description: Absolute path to the linter.py executable python file. If empty, falls back to $SVND_SCRIBE_HOME/linter/linter.py.

sv-nd-scribe.agentPath.description: Absolute path to the agent directory or agent.py. If empty, falls back to $SVND_SCRIBE_HOME/agent.

sv-nd-scribe.enableQuickFix.description: Enable Quick Fix (Code Action) recommendations for linter diagnostics.

sv-nd-scribe.env.description: Environment variables passed to the linter and agent processes (e.g. SVND_SCRIBE_HOME, PYTHONPATH, SV_ND_SCRIBE_PROJECT_CONFIG).

sv-nd-scribe.runOn.description: When to run the linter (onSave or onOpen).
